mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.6% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.6%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts indicate weakening aggregate demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% and rising signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing output and economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 205 indicates elevated inflation levels, which triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 205, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and declining labor force (PAYEMS < 137000) signal a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% and PAYEMS falls below 137000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110 (index 2017=100) during a recessionary regime signals manufacturing contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 110 during a recession, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
